note: P2 conservative variant (2026-08-24), refined by the bend-angle and corner-position mini-experiments. EVALUATED but NOT ADOPTED as production — the corner-concentration + absolute-speed-floor thresholds rest on 18+22 synthetic V-bend combos + 2 real sharp-corner cells; real intersection-corner sampling is recommended before adoption.

sharp_corner_zero.comment: discrete zero when max_turn>=20 AND cum>=20 AND max_turn/cum>=0.6 (a CONCENTRATED single corner, not a gradual curve)

absolute_speed_floor.comment: discrete zero when pedestrian-only baseline mean speed < 0.8 m/s. Closes the relative speed-retention artifact (R_v=v/v0>=1-delta is trivially satisfied for slow-but-uncongested corners); zero impact on the 200 real combos (all vbar<0.8 already q_r*=0).

q_max_extra_wide.comment: W > 3.0 m -> cap q_max at 15 (synthetic q_max=20 was only validated to W=3.0)

bend_sweep_finding.grid: theta {0,30,45,60,75,90} deg x W {2.0,2.5,3.0} m x qp=50 x 30 seeds = 18 combos
bend_sweep_finding.key_insight: a SINGLE sharp corner (middle V-bend) collapses robot throughput even at 30 deg (qr* 8-10 -> 0-2) at ALL widths; the operative feature is turn CONCENTRATION (max_turn/cum_turn ~1 for a corner vs <=0.5 for a gradual curve), which sinuosity cannot capture.

position_sweep_finding.grid: theta {0,15,20,30,45,60,75,90} deg x position {entry,middle,exit} x W=2.5 x qp=50 x 30 seeds = 22 combos
position_sweep_finding.key_insight_1: corner POSITION matters: an exit corner (short stub before the exit, as in AMS-1351790552) is a queueing bottleneck and collapses at 90 deg (qr*=0); an entry corner is more forgiving at mild angles (15-30 deg admit 6) but still collapses by 75 deg; middle corners collapse most monotonically.
position_sweep_finding.key_insight_2: relative-criterion ARTIFACT: entry-90 deg has baseline vbar=0.645 m/s (corner alone slows pedestrians ~46%) yet 'passes' at q_r=20 because R_v=v/v0>=0.90 is trivially satisfied on an already-slow baseline. An ABSOLUTE speed floor (vbar<0.8 -> 0) closes this gap with zero impact on the 200 real combos.
